annotations.text:
IT OPENS AS ONE SCROLLING PAGE.

This is a real page, not a picture of one. Scroll it top to bottom - that is the whole design.

The journey: nine year-panels. The big year and the company pin to the left while their story scrolls past, then swap when the next year arrives. The background carries the industry - teal for healthcare, blue for banking, orange for automotive, violet for the AI years - and blends where you change industry. The year chips at the top stay with you and jump you anywhere.

Other motion: a progress bar across the very top, blocks that rise as they come into view, a work strip you drag sideways, a stack ticker that never stops.

Collapse it to see the case study and the phone layout alongside.

STILL FOR YOU TO SETTLE

1. Dates. Express Scripts sits across 2018-19 and Bank of America in 2020 - only September 2018 and July 2021 are pinned by your record. Give me the real months.

2. Your email is a placeholder in the footer.

3. The photo frame in the hero is 3:4 for the waterfront shot. Save it to img/kushal.jpg.
